name: onepulse-mcp-servers
description: Real, pinned local install of the Azure DevOps MCP server the Investigation service spawns directly (see investigation/investigate.py's _ado_mcp_server_params). Migration Plan Phase 4: this lives inside investigation/ deliberately -- Node and this package exist only here, not the repo root, since Investigation is the only service that needs either. Installed as a normal dependency rather than resolved at spawn time via `npx -y` so a container build can `npm ci` it once, offline, at build time -- avoiding the runtime-fetch failure class found live 2026-09-09 (an interrupted npx install corrupted its own cache and broke the next real pipeline run; a container has no equivalent recovery path since it can't assume outbound network access at request time).
